stands_beside: v1.1. Amends no published number. Does not reopen PW-1.
criteria_template: Amendment_Criteria_Template.md at HEAD; every section-A rule applies by number
question: Every published comparison changes the words and moves the cuts at once. How much of the formatter's measured retrieval advantage survives when the original, unedited corpus is scored under the formatter's segmentation geometry -- i.e. when no word is changed at all?
treatment_definition: D_edit(m) = F(m) - S(m). RELABELLED per the G9 ruling: the TOTAL effect of enabling the editing pass, INCLUDING the boundary shift the editing induces. The shift is a downstream consequence of the treatment, not an outside variable; G9 falsified the description 'editing, holding seams and size', not the measurement.

UNCUT_ws.derivation: UNCUT units with re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text) applied to UNIT TEXT ONLY; source_ranges untouched; segmentation, provenance and unit count held exactly fixed

F_at_S.assignment_rule: Each of FULL's kept sentences is assigned to the SEAM segment containing the START of its first source range; sentences are concatenated in order within each segment and emitted through FULL's OWN _emit, so a unit's source_ranges are the union of its sentences' ranges by the same rule FULL applies. THE ASSIGNMENT RULE IS THE ARM DEFINITION; a different rule is a different experiment.
F_at_S.why_not_S_at_F: F@S is the conservative direction (it denies edited text its preferred seams, so a positive result survives its own worst case); it puts no treatment-derived information inside a control; and it is the direct-effect estimand the question asks for.

S_at_F.constraint: Its only reported use is the magnitude of the interaction between text and boundary placement. Never an alternative estimate of the editing effect, never in a decision rule, in no Holm family.

arms_defined_inline: Never in config/conditions/ -- all_condition_ids() globs that directory and a new YAML would silently join every future full run.

decomposition.D_ws(m): U(m)-ws - U(m)   [UPPER BOUND: collapsing \s+ also collapses intra-sentence runs, which _emit preserves]
decomposition.identity_status: WIRING CHECKS, NOT VALIDITY CHECKS. Both telescope by construction. They catch a transposed variable; they are not evidence the decomposition means anything.
decomposition.null_is_not_decomposed: If D_edit is indistinguishable from zero the branch is KILL and the split is NOT reported as a finding -- decomposing a null is arithmetic on noise. Frozen before the value exists.
decomposition.D_reseam_is_not_zero_by_construction: F@S differs from F on 45/45 Track A documents, measured at d43063f. A zero D_reseam would therefore be an empirical result about retrieval, not an artifact of the arm.

primary_metric.name: recall@budget
primary_metric.rule: units in rank order, include the unit that crosses B, stop; realised k recorded per query per arm
primary_metric.not_comparable: recall@budget is a NEW metric in a NEW experiment. It is not comparable to any published number and is never printed beside one without that sentence attached.

s2_equals_s3_assertion_scope: NO-DEDUP arms only: UNCUT, UNCUT-ws, SEAM. F@S and FULL inherit dedup and would fire it spuriously.
inheritance_path_not_exercised: No arm uses formatted_naive, so formatted.py:86-94 is not exercised.

environment_pins.embedding_model: pinned explicitly on the CLI and here; NEVER inherited from config/default.yaml, whose default is bge
environment_pins.native_stack: recorded per run via the _environment() block copied from common_size_ci.py

P1.text: D_size(768) is large and positive, >= +0.10 on recall@5

P2.text: D_size(768) shrinks substantially under recall@budget relative to recall@5
P2.falsified_if: it does not shrink, or grows

P3.text: D_seam(768) is small, |D_seam| <= +0.05, CI includes zero
P3.sighted_values: formed with the published 768 row in view; see prior_knowledge_at_freeze

P4.text: D_edit(768) under recall@budget is positive but small, <= +0.05, and may not exclude zero
P4.sighted_values: formed with the published 768 row in view; see prior_knowledge_at_freeze

P5.text: Under recall@budget the UNCUT ordering across 128..768 is flatter than under recall@5

P6.text: D_reseam(768) is small and non-negative under recall@budget
P6.falsified_if: significantly negative, or exceeds D_text in magnitude
P6.blind_because: no published number decomposes the editing effect

P7.text: D_text(768) carries the MAJORITY of D_edit(768) under recall@budget, conditional on D_edit(768) being distinguishable from zero
P7.falsified_if: D_text is less than half of D_edit, or is itself indistinguishable from zero while D_edit is not
P7.blind_because: no published number decomposes the editing effect
P7.pre_committed_failure_branch: If D_edit is positive and D_text is not -- the whole benefit sitting in D_reseam -- the honest statement is 'the editing pass helps, and it helps by changing where the cuts fall rather than by improving the text.' That is the opposite of what this programme has claimed and is REPORTED AT THE SAME PROMINENCE a confirmation would receive.

prior_knowledge_at_freeze.statement: Gate 0 G10 established that SEAM IS the published condition C3-markeronly (same parameter set; run.py:230-232 supplies C3's swept 768). Rebuilt: 90 units, token_mean 609.84, identical to published. The entire 768 row of this design is therefore already on the published record, and P3 and P4 were formed with these values in view.
prior_knowledge_at_freeze.consequence: Under recall@5 at m=768 this design is a REPRODUCTION CHECK. The genuinely new information is the recall@budget(1920) metric, the sizes other than 768, and the F@S arm.
prior_knowledge_at_freeze.reproduction_void_across_embedders: These are all-MiniLM-L6-v2 values. The check is live in cell A-MiniLM only; no reproduction claim may be made from A-bge (Template section B).
prior_knowledge_at_freeze.published_values_are_not_comparators: Motivation and disclosure only. They enter no arm and no v1.6 number is computed from them. Published C0 is a REPRODUCTION TARGET; every decomposition term comes from arms run in this experiment.

design_amendments_before_freeze.assertion: NO ARM VALUE HAD BEEN COMPUTED AT THE TIME OF ANY AMENDMENT BELOW. Nothing was scored, retrieved or embedded. Every amendment rests on code and artifact facts. The arm set was FINAL at the freeze commit.
design_amendments_before_freeze.why_recorded: A later reader sees a design that moved and would otherwise have to take on trust that it moved for the right reasons. Recorded, the amendment history is evidence: a design corrected by scrutiny before it could be corrected by results.

amendments.what_changed: The verbatim-partition gate was weakened to three parts: whitespace-normalised equality, exact coverage of every NON-WHITESPACE character, non-overlap.
amendments.caused_by: G6 failed 10/10 Track A documents on whitespace alone. _emit joins sentences with a single space (formatter.py:302) and sentence_spans excludes inter-sentence whitespace. No word, identifier or number changed.

amendments.what_changed: SEAM moved to the deterministic path via markers_only: True.
amendments.caused_by: The LLM path is gated on markers_only, not on reference_resolution/dedup (formatter.py:184), and _chunk_llm calls complete() unconditionally. With both ops off the system prompt's ops list is empty, so the cache key differs: FULL 45/45 cached, SEAM 0/45. Correctness first -- it keeps a generative model out of the arm whose value rests on unchanged text -- and 45 avoided calls second.

amendments.what_changed: Halt condition 7 reversed. Published C0 established as U768 at overlap_frac 0.0; reproduction target, not comparator.
amendments.caused_by: A conservation identity, tightened at d43063f to integer token counts: corpus 54,886 tokens vs U768@0.0's 54,886 (residual +0), and unit count 90 vs 91 at overlap 0.1 and 95 at 0.2. Two exact integer signals.

amendments.what_changed: D_edit RELABELLED as the total effect including the induced boundary shift; the F@S arm and the D_text/D_reseam split ADDED; F_MECH family added; 'a null D_edit is not decomposed' frozen.
amendments.caused_by: FALSIFIED. _right_size groups by count_tokens(st.text) over st.kept and the LLM sets both, so 0/45 Track A documents share boundaries between SEAM(768) and FULL(768); A-000 moves its interior boundary 283 characters.

amendments.what_changed: prior_knowledge_at_freeze became a substantial field; the reproduction-check framing added to plan section 0.
amendments.caused_by: SEAM IS the published C3-markeronly -- 90 units, token_mean 609.84, identical.

amendments.what_changed: Recorded as a Gate-0 finding, not fixed.
amendments.caused_by: markers_only overrides right_size (formatter.py:243): right-sizing runs regardless. A reader of C3-markeronly.yaml alone would predict 1552 units, not 90.

amendments.what_changed: The empty-segment test split in two: a corpus-independent behavioural assertion with a CONSTRUCTED fixture, and a Track-A-only measurement pinned at zero. Other corpora report and continue.
amendments.caused_by: One test asserted a corpus fact under a behavioural name, so the first corpus with an empty segment would have failed with a message saying the code padded something when the code was correct.

design_amendments_before_freeze.not_fixed_deliberately: Neither _emit's join separator nor formatter.py:243's right_size override is repaired. Repairing the object under measurement would mean F768 no longer reproduces the published C3 corpus, and that reproduction is one of the few things tying this experiment to the published record.

decision_rules.ADOPT: D_edit significantly positive on recall@budget(1920) in cell A-MiniLM, after Holm within family F_EDIT, AND directionally positive in cell A-bge
decision_rules.ADOPT_SCOPED: D_edit significantly positive but confined to exactly one pre-named admissible scope. Admissible scopes, enumerated in advance and CLOSED: {m=384 only}, {m=768 only}, {Track A only}, {all-MiniLM-L6-v2 only}, {strict variant only}. A scope not in this list is a HYPOTHESIS, not a verdict
decision_rules.KILL: D_edit not statistically distinguishable from zero on recall@budget(1920) in cell A-MiniLM
decision_rules.REJECT_HARM: D_edit significantly NEGATIVE in cell A-MiniLM -- same rule as ADOPT with the sign reversed

branch_precedence: REJECT_HARM takes precedence over KILL when both could apply; a harm finding is reported as harm, never as a null
harm_reporting_rule: a significant negative is reported in the direction it fell, with the same prominence a positive would receive

consequence_rules.KILL: the white paper's claim is amended to 'better segmentation retrieves better; editing is not separately demonstrated at matched retrieval budget.' Readability and verbatim-guardrail results are unaffected and stay as written.
consequence_rules.ADOPT_SCOPED: the claim is restated with the scope named in the headline sentence, not in a footnote.
consequence_rules.REJECT_HARM: reported as harm, at the same prominence a gain would get.
consequence_rules.every_branch: D_size and D_seam are reported as first-class results regardless of what D_edit does. They are the reason the experiment exists.

holm_families.excluded: A-bge and B-MiniLM are in NO family. S@F carries no p-value anyone acts on.

one_shot_rule: Re-testing D_edit on this Track A split after seeing this result is not a fresh test. A v1.7 must use a different track or a freshly generated corpus.
reporting_rule: Every quantity named in the decomposition and every prediction is reported in whichever direction it falls, including P4's and P7's failure, and including any mismatch between F768 and published C3.
halt_conditions: 1. G6 fails in its three-part form under the final SEAM configuration
2. S2 != S3 on a NO-DEDUP arm (UNCUT, UNCUT-ws, SEAM). Scoped: does not apply to F@S or FULL
3. Either decomposition identity fails to hold to exact equality on point estimates (WIRING check)
4. Any arm's source_ranges fall outside [0, len(doc.text)), or a no-dedup arm's claimed character count exceeds the document length
5. Track A triggers any fresh LLM call -- should be unreachable; if it fires it is a finding about the deterministic path
6. Track B would trigger fresh LLM spend not served from cache/
7. WITHDRAWN. G2 established published C0 as U768 at overlap 0.0; reproduction target, not comparator; every decomposition term comes from arms run in this experiment
8. Anything would be written to results/, or to any posthoc_PW1_* or preregistration_*.json path
9. The bge cell segfaults mid-corpus -> use --sharded-encode (bit-identical, tests/test_pw1_safe_encode.py) and record it
10. Any arm value computed before this pre-registration is committed -- not recoverable; stop and report
11. The F@S regrouping gate fails, or the sentence->segment assignment rule is not constructible as specified

G6_three_part.result: PASS 45/45 Track A, under the final markers_only configuration; re-checked at m=384

gold_span_overlap.result: PASS -- every gold span in the Track A test set overlaps at least one SEAM source_range

F_at_S_regrouping.result: PASS 45/45; 90 F@S units vs 90 SEAM segments; 0 empty segments; demonstrated failing on a dropped AND a duplicated unit

stats.boundary_rule: a CI bound of exactly 0.0000 does NOT exclude zero
stats.exact_p: exact_signflip_p where the outcome is paired binary

process_finding_not_yet_acted_on.finding: A swept parameter (C0's overlap_frac) went unpersisted and survived only because the metric happened to admit a conservation check.
process_finding_not_yet_acted_on.candidate_rule: Every parameter a sweep selects is persisted in the run manifest, alongside the value it beat.
process_finding_not_yet_acted_on.status: Goes to Amendment_Criteria_Template.md AFTER v1.6 closes. Governing documents do not change while an experiment citing them is in flight.

frozen_at.note: the freeze COMMIT hash is recorded in the results document; this field records HEAD at the moment the file was written
